name: Document Processing Desk
description: Turns approved business documents into a source-traced field register, validation exceptions, and a controlled review queue without inventing unreadable or missing values.

accepts: business document text or approved OCR
intake.description: Approved document text or OCR, the exact fields to capture, source labels, validation rules, and known limits. Unreadable or absent values remain explicit exceptions.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Inventory each source, document type, page or section reference, requested field, effective date, and known readability issue without guessing missing content.

roles.title: Field Extractor
roles.goal: Extract only requested business fields, preserve units and exact source references, normalize explicitly permitted formats, and mark ambiguous values for review.

roles.title: Document Validator
roles.goal: Check required-field coverage, duplicates, conflicting values, date validity, and source traceability, then prepare the smallest human review queue.

output_contract.description: A source-traced document register with explicit validation results and exceptions for human review.
